headline: Fort Hays State complete an unbeaten conference season
dek: Fort Hays State beat Southern Nazarene to close their conference schedule with eleven wins and a draw from twelve matches for 34 points, the draw at Rogers State the only points they dropped. Rogers State, second on 18 points with one match left, can finish no closer than thirteen points behind them.
displaced_by: Harding's draw with Rogers State means they have no longer lost all their conference matches, so the standing dek's second sentence is untrue; the headline's story stands and is kept.
